assessment.title: Grower Assessment
assessment.description: The Wisconsin Cranberry Board is funded through a grower assessment on each barrel of cranberries produced in Wisconsin. These funds are reinvested directly into programs that benefit the entire cranberry industry.
assessment.rateDescription: The Board unanimously voted to increase the assessment rate from 10¢ to 25¢ per barrel for the 2025 growing season. This increase bolsters support for current projects and ensures resources are available to address future industry challenges.
assessment.producerNote: More than 300 licensed cranberry producers across Wisconsin contribute to the assessment, which generates approximately $550,000+ annually in funding for research, education, and promotion programs.

allocation.title: Where Your Assessment Goes
allocation.note: Approximate allocation — actual percentages vary by year based on Board priorities.

elections.title: Board Elections & Participation
elections.description: The Wisconsin Cranberry Board is composed of seven grower-members, each serving a three-year term. Elections are administered by DATCP, with nominations typically opening each April.
elections.howToRunTitle: How to Run for the Board
steps: Nominations open each April through DATCP
Must be a licensed Wisconsin cranberry producer
Submit nomination forms by the posted deadline
Ballots are mailed to all licensed producers
elections.meetingsDescription: The Wisconsin Cranberry Board meets regularly throughout the year to review proposals, approve funding, and set strategic direction for the industry.
elections.meetingsPublicNote: Meetings are open to the public. For meeting schedules and agendas, contact the Board office.
